cues: At a radiation exhibit, a guide discusses potassium-40 in a common snack to illustrate naturally occurring radioactivity.
In chemistry class, isoamyl acetate's characteristic candy-like aroma helps students identify a familiar tropical flavor.
A plant pathology seminar examines a persistent soil fungus that once threatened the world's leading tropical export crop.
A botanic garden grows the giant perennial herb in a warm glasshouse, displaying its unusual scale beside ordinary orchard plants.
A dietitian recommends a potassium-rich, mild snack as part of a meal plan for managing high blood pressure.
An East African household ferments mashed tropical fruit with sorghum flour, producing a mildly alcoholic traditional beer.
